text: まひすると　わざが　ときどき　でなく　なり　すばやさも　さがって　しまいます！

structure.jp: わざが　ときどき　でなく　なり
structure.en: moves sometimes stop coming out, and

structure.jp: すばやさも　さがって　しまいます！

patterns.name: 〜なくなる
patterns.explanation: A 'not' form ending in なく plus なる says something stops happening. Leaving なる as なり joins it to the next part like 'and'. でなく なり = 'stop coming out, and'.

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: さがって　しまいます
patterns.explanation: しまう after a て-form verb says the thing happens completely, often as bad luck. さがって しまいます = 'it goes and drops'.

patterns.name: 〜と (when/if)
patterns.explanation: と after a plain verb says that whenever that happens, the next thing always follows. まひすると = 'when it gets paralyzed'.
